verdict.rationale: Mercury documents debit and credit cards on accounts, cards for team spend with limits and controls, and granular user permissions, so issuing cards to employees under defined permissions is supported. However, no evidence explicitly mentions physical card issuance; the only explicit issuance evidence covers virtual cards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical debit/credit card issuance to employees, documented role definitions tied to cardholders, and independent corroboration of physical card workflows.
